This is every cell of the spec's table,\n20\t# including every disallowed combination.\n21\tCASES: list[tuple[str, str, str, bool, str | None]] = [\n22\t    # draft --submit--> pending: the Post's own author, any role.\n23\t    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, \"pending\"),\n24\t    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", True, \"pending\"),\n25\t    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", False, None),  # another Ambassador's draft\n26\t    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", False, None),  # admin isn't the author\n27\t    # draft --publish (self-publish)--> published: admin, own Post only.\n28\t    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n29\t    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, None),  # someone else's draft\n30\t    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),  # editor can never publish\n31\t    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n32\t    # pending --publish--> published: any admin, regardless of author.\n33\t    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n34\t    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, \"published\"),\n35\t    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n36\t    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n37\t    # pending --bounce--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n38\t    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n39\t    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n40\t    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", True, None),\n41\t    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", False, None),\n42\t    # published --unpublish--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n43\t    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n44\t    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n45\t    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n46\t    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n47\t    # No other (status, action) pair exists at all.\n48\t    (\"draft\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n49\t    (\"draft\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n50\t    (\"pending\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n51\t    (\"pending\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n52\t    (\"published\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n53\t    (\"published\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n54\t]\n55\t\n56\t\n57\t@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status,action,role,is_author,expected\", CASES)\n58\tdef test_transition_table(status, action, role, is_author, expected):\n59\t    if expected is None:\n60\t        with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n61\t            review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n62\t    else:\n63\t        assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected\n64\t\n65\t\n66\t@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status\", STATUSES)\n67\t@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n68\t@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"is_author\", [True, False])\n69\tdef test_available_actions_matches_transition_table(status, role, is_author):\n70\t    \"\"\"available_actions() must agree with transition() for every action,\n71\t    not just the ones CASES happens to spell out disallowed combos for.\"\"\"\n72\t    allowed = review_gate.available_actions(status, role, is_author)\n73\t    for action in ACTIONS:\n74\t        try:\n75\t            expected_target = review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n76\t        except ValueError:\n77\t            assert action not in allowed\n78\t        else:\n79\t            assert action in allowed\n80\t            # available_actions must not have side effects or disagree on the target.\n81\t            assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected_target\n82\t\n83\t\n84\t# --- HTTP seam: the routes wire the above into the Posts admin screens -----\n85\t\n86\t\n87\tdef Posts — the review-gate state machine (ADR-004).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import review_gate\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\nSTATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nACTIONS = [\"submit\", \"publish\", \"bounce\", \"unpublish\"]\n\n# Every (status, action, role, is_author) -> expected target status, or None\n# if the transition must be rejected. This is every cell of the spec's table,\n# including every disallowed combination.\nCASES: list[tuple[str, str, str, bool, str | None]] = [\n    # draft --submit--> pending: the Post's own author, any role.\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", False, None),  # another Ambassador's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", False, None),  # admin isn't the author\n    # draft --publish (self-publish)--> published: admin, own Post only.\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, None),  # someone else's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),  # editor can never publish\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --publish--> published: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --bounce--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # published --unpublish--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # No other (status, action) pair exists at all.\n    (\"draft\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"draft\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status,action,role,is_author,expected\", CASES)\ndef test_transition_table(status, action, role, is_author, expected):\n    if expected is None:\n        with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n            review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n    else:\n        assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status\", STATUSES)\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"is_author\", [True, False])\ndef test_available_actions_matches_transition_table(status, role, is_author):\n    \"\"\"available_actions() must agree with transition() for every action,\n    not just the ones CASES happens to spell out disallowed combos for.\"\"\"\n    allowed = review_gate.available_actions(status, role, is_author)\n    for action in ACTIONS:\n        try:\n            expected_target = review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n        except ValueError:\n            assert action not in allowed\n        else:\n            assert action in allowed\n            # available_actions must not have side effects or disagree on the target.\n            assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected_target\n\n\n# --- HTTP seam: the routes python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n# Cycled too, so the review-gate workflow (ADR-004) is visible on a fresh\n# clone (T04 acceptance): at least one Post in each status.\nPOST_STATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        topic = POST_TOPICS[i % len(POST_TOPICS)]\n        status = POST_STATUSES[i % len(POST_STATUSES)]\n        title = f\"My first week at {program.title}\"\n        post = models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n        if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n        if status == \"published\":\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n    print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} posts across Topics and statuses \"\n          \"(draft/pending/published) under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo SQLite connection handling (no ORM, per ADR-002).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')) DEFAULT 'draft',\n    show_in_footer INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    author_id INTEGER,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- At most one root (parent_id IS NULL) Page — the single Home — ever exists.\nCREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pages_single_home ON pages((1)) WHERE parent_id IS NULL;\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    program_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n path).exists(), f\"{label} present\", path, f\"create {path}\")\n        if stage >= 2:\n            handoffs = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"handoff\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n            self.add(bool(handoffs), \"at least one handoff saved\", f\"{len(handoffs)} file(s)\",\n                     \"copy a /handoff document into docs/handoff/\")\n\n    def naming(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        reports = list((ROOT / \"docs\").glob(\"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_*.md\"))\n        if stage >= 2:\n            ok = any(REPORT.match(p.name) for p in reports)\n            self.add(ok, \"report named correctly\",\n                     \", \".join(p.name for p in reports) or \"missing\",\n                     \"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md, lowercase\")\n        transcripts = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"transcripts\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n        bad = [p.name for p in transcripts if not TRANSCRIPT.match(p.name)]\n        self.add(transcripts and not bad, \"transcripts present and named correctly\",\n                 f\"{len(transcripts)} file(s); bad: {bad or 'none'}\",\n                 \"iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_{NN}_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md\")\n\n    def readme(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        if stage < 2:\n            return\n        text = (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text() if (ROOT / \"README.md\").exists() else \"\"\n        for needle, label in [(\"http\", \"live URL\"), (\"Run locally\", \"run-locally section\"),\n                              (\"Generative AI Use Statement\", \"AI Use Statement\")]:\n            self.add(needle.lower() in text.lower(), f\"README has {label}\", \"\",\n                     f\"add the {label} to README.md\")\n        placeholder = \"*(Required. Replace this section\" in text\n        self.add(not placeholder, \"AI Use Statement was rewritten\", \"\",\n                 \"replace the template placeholder with your own statement\")\n\n    def screenshots(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        if stage < 2:\n            return\n        files = {p.name.lower() for p in (ROOT / \"docs\" / \"screenshots\").glob(\"*\")}\n        missing = [f\"{s}-{w}\" for s in SCREENS for w in (1280, 390)\n                   if not any(s in n and str(w) in n for n in files)]\n        self.add(not missing, \"12 screenshots present\", \", \".join(missing) or \"all present\",\n                 \"docs/screenshots/{screen}-{1280|390}.png for each of: \" + \", \".join(SCREENS))\n\n    def git_state(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        tags = sh(\"git\", \"tag\").split()\n        want = [\"mp2-mvp\"] + ([\"mp2-final\"] if stage >= 2 else [])\n        for tag in want:\n            self.add(tag in tags, f\"tag {tag} exists\", \", \".join(tags) or \"none\",\n                     f\"git tag {tag} && git push --tags\")\n        paths = sh(\"git\", \"grep\", \"-l\", '-e', 'href=\"/', \"-e\", 'src=\"/', \"--\", \"*.html\")\n        self.add(not paths.strip(), \"no root-absolute paths in HTML\", paths.strip() or \"clean\",\n                 'use relative paths (\"style.css\"), not \"/style.css\"')\n\n    def tests(self) -> None:\n        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pytest\", \"-q\"], cwd=ROOT,\n                             capture_output=True, text=True)\n        self.add(run.returncode == 0, \"test suite passes\",\n                 run.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if run.stdout else \"\",\n                 \"fix failing tests before submitting\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = Checks()\n    c.hygiene()\n    if args.stage == 0:\n        for path in [\"app/main.py\", \"scripts/seed_demo.py\", \".claude/settings.json\",\n                     \"CLAUDE.md\", \"SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md\"]:\n            c.add((ROOT / path).exists(), f\"template file {path}\", \"\", \"restore from the dev repo\")\n    else:\n        c.docs(args.stage)\n        c.naming(args.stage)\n        c.readme(args.stage)\n        c.screenshots(args.stage)\n        c.git_state(args.stage)\n        c.tests()\n\n    failures = [r for r in c.results if not r[\"ok\"]]\n    if args.json:\n        print(json.dumps({\"stage\": args.stage, \"failures\": len(failures),\n                          \"results\": c.results}, indent=2))\n    else:\n        for r in c.results:\n Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n49\t                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n50\t        return result.returncode\n51\t    return 1\n52\t\n53\t\n54\tif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n55\t    raise SystemExit(main())\n56\t"}]},"uuid":"17a5015b-9deb-4aad-a64b-cc19b6b342e4","timestamp":"2026-10-05T21:42:33.931Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/cli.py","content":"\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n","numLines":56,"startLine":1,"totalLines":56}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"881bba84-4e02-490c-8387-0df384a19db9","session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ecbd4ac9-c31b-4122-bcf3-3f98866c8a5b","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

 if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such page\")\n    return page\n\n\ndef _render_form(request, page: models.Page | None, parent_id: int, error: str | None = \"title\": \"Edit page\" if page else \"New page\",\n            \"page\": page,\n            \"parent\": parent,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_pages(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n\n    def tree(page: models.Page) -> list[dict]:\n        return [\n            {\"page\": child, \"children\": tree(child)}\n            for child in models.list_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_page_form(\n    request: Request, parent_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    return _render_form(request, page=None, show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    page = _get_page_or_404(page_id)\n    if not )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_page(\n    page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    try:\n {\"title\": post.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, post_chain)}\n                ]\n                post_html = post_template.render(\n                    title=post.title,\n \"published\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"public/page.html\",\n        {\"title\": page.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, )","originalFile":"\"\"\"The public site, served live from the database.\n\nThis is the admin console's \"preview\" the Pages ticket asks for: Staff see a\npublished change here immediately, before anyone runs `cms publish`. It and\nthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\napp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n\nOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef resolve(path: str) -> tuple[str, models.Page] | tuple[str, models.Post, models.Page] | None:\n    \"\"\"A Page by its full path, or — one segment further, under a Program —\n    a published Post by slug. Returns None on no match.\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n    current = home\n    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):\n        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n        if child is not None:\n            current = child\n            continue\n        if i == len(segments) - 1 and models.is_program_page(current):\n            post = models.get_published_post_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n            if post is not None:\n                return \"post\", post, current\n        return None\n    return \"page\", current\n\n\ndef _path_for(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"/\"\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(page) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(page.slug)\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n\n\ndef page_context(page: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = {"parentUuid":"b34b35ce-57bb-4752-8b17-6b1bbebec005","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfjpZTnCy9AgwnAxsXbVE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01EPqWo9Ygmo5YzmSHZ8xZok","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t05.py","content":"\"\"\"T05: Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"../style.css\" in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    seed_demo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(seed_demo)\n\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = \"t05-seed-site\")\n    try:\n        published = [\n            p for program in programs\n            for p in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n        ]\n        assert post.slug, \"index.html\")\n                assert post_path.exists()\n                html = post_path.read_text()\n                assert 'href=\"/' not in html and 'src=\"/' not in html\n Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"../style.css\" in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"../style.css\" in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html  # relative link to the post\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html","originalFile":"\"\"\"T05: Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"../style.css\" in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    seed_demo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(seed_demo)\n\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    published = [\n        p for program in programs\n        for p in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n    ]\n    assert published\n    for program in programs:\n        program_chain = [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]] + [program.slug]\n        for post in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id):\n            post_path = out.joinpath(*program_chain, Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft or pending Post, like a\n     draft Page, reaching site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Kenyon purple, per the T05 design acceptance. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --card-border: #DCCFEA;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  max-width: 60rem;\n  padding: 0 1rem 2rem;\n  color: var(--ink);\n}\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\nheader {\n  background: var(--purple);\n  margin: 0 -1rem;\n  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;\n}\n.site-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1.25rem;\n}\n.site-nav a { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n.site-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }\nmain { margin-block: 1.5rem; }\n.breadcrumb { font-size: 0.9rem; margin-block: 1rem; color: #5a5064; }\n.breadcrumb a { color: inherit; }\n\n.card-grid {\n  list-style: none;\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(14rem, 1fr));\n  gap: 1rem;\n  margin: 1rem 0;\n  padding: 0;\n}\n.card {\n  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  padding: 1rem;\n  background: var(--purple-light);\n}\n.card a { text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; }\n.post-meta { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #5a5064; margin: 0.35rem 0 0; }\n.post-topic-badge {\n  display: inline-block;\n  background: var(--purple);\n  color: #fff;\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.15rem 0.75rem;\n  font-size: 0.8rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.topic-filters {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 1rem 0;\n}\n.topic-pill {\n  border: 1px solid var(--purple);\n  background: #fff;\n  color: var(--purple-dark);\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;\n  font: inherit;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n.topic-pill.is-active { background: var(--purple); color: #fff; }\n\nfooter {\n  border-top: 1px solid var(--card-border);\n  margin-top: 2rem;\n  padding-top: 1rem;\n}\n.site-footer-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1rem;\n}\n\n@media (max-width: 480px) {\n  .site-nav, .site-footer-nav { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; }\n  .card-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }\n}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _slug_chain(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> list[str]:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return []\n    return [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id] + [page.slug]\n\n\ndef _relative_link(from_chain: list[str], to_chain: list[str]) -> str:\n    up = \"../\" * len(from_chain)\n    if not to_chain:\n        return f\"{up}index.html\" if up else \"index.html\"\n    return f\"{up}{'/'.join(to_chain)}/index.html\"\n\n\ndef _furniture(\n    chain: list[str],\n    home: models.Page,\n    continents: list[models.Page],\n    footer_pages: list[models.Page],\n    chains: dict[int, list[str]],\n) -> tuple[str, list[dict], list[dict]]:\n    \"\"\"CSS path, nav, and footer links for the page/post living at `chain` —\n    shared between a Page's own render and each of its Posts' renders.\"\"\"\n    css_path = _relative_link(chain, [])[: -len(\"index.html\")] + \"style.css\"\n    nav = [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, [])}] + [\n        {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n        for c in continents\n    ]\n    footer_links = [\n        {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[f.id])}\n        for f in footer_pages\n    ]\n    return css_path, nav, footer_links\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    all_pages = models.list_all_pages()\n    chains = {p.id: _slug_chain(p, home) for p in all_pages}\n\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n\n    page_template = env.get_template(\"public/page.html\")\n    post_template = env.get_template(\"public/post.html\")\n\n    for page in all_pages:\n        if page.status != \"published\":\n            continue\n        chain = chains[page.id]\n        css_path, nav, footer_links = _furniture(chain, home, continents, footer_pages, chains)\n        breadcrumb = [\n            {\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[a.id])}\n            for a in models.list_ancestors(page)\n        ] + [{\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chain)}]\n        children = [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n            for c in models.list_published_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n        post_groups = None\n        if models.is_program_page(page):\n            posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n            post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n                posts, lambda post: _relative_link(chain, chain + [post.slug])\n            )\n\n        html = page_template.render(\n            title=page.title,\n            page=page,\n            body_html=markdown.render(page.body),\n            css_path=css_path,\n            nav=nav,\n            breadcrumb=breadcrumb,\n page_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        (page_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(html)\n\n        if not post_groups:\n            continue\n        for _topic_value, _topic_label, summaries in post_groups:\n            for summary in summaries:\n                post = summary[\"post\"]\n                post_chain = chain + [post.slug]\n                post_css_path, post_nav, {\"title\": post.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, post_chain)}\n                ]\n                post_html = post_template.render(\n                    title=post.title,\n     footer_links=post_footer_links,\n                    program_href=_relative_link(post_chain, chain),\n                    program_title=page.title,\n                )\n                post_dir = # breadcrumb: Home\n    assert f'{expected_up}style.css' in post_html","originalFile":"\"\"\"T05: Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html  # relative link to the post\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"../style.css\" in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    seed_demo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(seed_demo)\n\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    published = [\n        p for program in programs\n        for p in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n    ]\n    assert published\n    for program in programs:\n        program_chain = [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]] + [program.slug]\n        for post in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id):\n            post_path = out.joinpath(*program_chain,
