'href=\"../../../../index.html\"' in post_html  # breadcrumb: Home\n    assert \"../../../../style.css\" in post_html","originalFile":"\"\"\"T05: Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html  # relative link to the post\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n    # A Post's page lives one level deeper than its Program, so every furniture\n    # link (not just the nav) must climb one more \"../\" than the Program's own\n    # page does, or the breadcrumb/stylesheet 404s from the deployed site.\n    up_count = post.slug and len(\"asia/japan/kyoto-exchange\".split(\"/\")) + 1\n    expected_up = \"../\" * up_count\n    assert f'href=\"{expected_up}index.html\"' in post_html  # breadcrumb: Home\n    assert f'{expected_up}style.css' in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    seed_demo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(seed_demo)\n\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    published = [\n        p for program in programs\n        for p in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n    ]\n    assert published\n    for program in programs:\n        program_chain = [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]] + [program.slug]\n        for post in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id):\n            post_path = out.joinpath(*program_chain, I have enough to compile the review findings.\n\n## Code review findings — T05 (issue #6)\n\n**Correctness vs. acceptance criteria**\n- Grouped/filterable by Topic: implemented correctly in both `templates/public/page.html` (client-side `.topic-pill` filter) and the shared `app/models.group_posts_by_topic` / `app/services/post_view.grouped_post_summaries`. Confirmed by passing tests.\n- Sanitized Markdown: both render paths call `markdown.render(post.body)` consistently; test `test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown` exercises it meaningfully (strips `&lt;script&gt;`, converts `**world**`).\n- Draft/pending never public: `models.list_published_posts_by_program` and `get_published_post_by_slug` both filter `status = 'published'` at the SQL level; `app/publish.py`'s `render_site` only computes `post_groups` for pages with `status == \"published\"`. Verified with a passing test and manual trace.\n- `cms publish` writes every published Post under its Program path with relative links: confirmed via `_furniture(post_chain, ...)` and the explicit `post_breadcrumb` both correctly keyed off `post_chain` (one level deeper than `chain`), and via `scripts/check_submission.py`'s grep (no `href=\"/` or `src=\"/` in any tracked `.html`, confirmed by running `git grep`).\n- Slug freeze after publish: covered by pre-existing `update_post`/`create_page` logic (`slug = post.slug  # frozen...`), exercised by `test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish`. Not part of this diff but correctly relied upon.\n- `seed_demo` end-to-end: `test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish` actually imports and runs `scripts/seed_demo.py`'s `_seed_pages`/`_seed_posts` and renders the site, then checks every published post's file exists and has no absolute links. Good, substantive test.\n- Kenyon purple design / nav / breadcrumbs / cards / footer: present in the new CSS and `base.html`/`page.html`/`post.html`. Single `@media (max-width: 480px)` breakpoint collapses nav and card grid to one column; at 390px width this should render without horizontal scroll (not verified visually/with a browser, only by reading CSS).\n\n**Bugs**\n- None found of the \"wrong chain\" class beyond the breadcrumb bug you already fixed. I specifically checked `_furniture` (css/nav/footer), the explicit `post_breadcrumb` block, and `post_groups`' href-for-posts callback (`app/publish.py:post_groups` uses `chain`, correctly, since that href is rendered *on* the Program page, not the Post page) — all consistently use the entity's own chain.\n- `app/routes/public.py:resolve()`: when resolving a Post, the parent Program's own `status` is never checked (only the Post's `status='published'` is, via `get_published_post_by_slug`). In principle a published Post under a since-unpublished Program is still reachable by direct URL in the live-preview route, even though `cms publish` would correctly omit it (since `render_site` skips non-published pages entirely). This mirrors the pre-existing laxness of Page resolution (ancestor status was never checked there either), so it's consistent with existing design rather than a new regression — but it is a live-preview/static-export behavior divergence worth a one-line comment or a ticket, not a hard blocker.\n\n**Hard constraints (CLAUDE.md)**\n- Relative-only links: verified with `git grep -e 'href=\"/' -e 'src=\"/' -- '*.html'` across all tracked HTML — clean. The dynamic `href=\"/...\"` values built in `app/routes/public.py`'s `_path_for`/`page_context`/`post_context` are root-absolute by design (that route is served live from the FastAPI app root, not a static subfolder) and don't appear literally in any `.html` file, so they don't trip the grep-based check — correctly scoped to the static export only.\n- Markdown sanitization: confirmed present on every render path that touches Post body.\n\n**Code quality / duplication**\n- `app/routes/public.py:post_context()` (around the `author = models.get_user_by_id(...)`, `topic_label`, `published_date` lines) duplicates exactly what `app/services/post_view._author_name`, `_published_date`, and `post_summary()` already compute, instead of calling `post_view.post_summary(post, post_href)` and spreading its fields. This is precisely the kind of divergence the shared helper was introduced to prevent — right now a change to author-fallback text or date formatting has to be made in two places. Minor but should be fixed to actually realize the \"shared helper\" intent stated in `post_view.py`'s own docstring.\n- `resolve()`'s return type (`tuple[str, Page] | tuple[str, Post, Page] | None`, \"kind\" tag as a bare string `\"page\"`/`\"post\"`) is a bit stringly-typed/awkward to destructure (`_kind, page = resolved`), but it's localized and test-covered; not a correctness issue, just a readability nit.\n- `_furniture()` is a solid de-duplication win between the Page-render and Post-render loops in `publish.py` — used consistently, no logic left duplicated there.\n\n**Test quality (tests/test_t05.py)**\n- Assertions are meaningful and specific (not tautological): e.g. checking exact relative-link strings (`'href=\"../../../../index.html\"'`), checking a 404 for direct draft/pending slug access, checking slug freeze value exactly, checking sanitized output excludes `&lt;script&gt;` while including converted Markdown.\n- One soft spot: `test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic` asserts `\"Housing\" in response.text` and `\"Meals\" in response.text` — since \"Housing\"/\"Meals\" also appear as topic-pill button labels, this doesn't strictly prove the Posts are grouped under the right section (only that the words appear somewhere on the page). The topic-pill `data-topic=\"housing\"` assertion partially compensates, but nothing asserts the post titles are inside the correct `&lt;section data-topic=\"...\"&gt;` block specifically. Low severity — the exporter/model-level grouping logic is unit-testable at the `group_posts_by_topic` level and isn't separately tested here, only through the end-to-end HTTP path.\n- Good: all new tests run and pass (`6 passed`), and the full suite (`109 passed`) is unaffected.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>69106</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>27</tool_uses><duration_ms>158595</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

in response.text","originalFile":"\"\"\"T05: Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Housing\" in response.text and \"Meals\" in response.text\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in response.text\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in response.text\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html  # relative link to the post\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n    # A Post's page lives one level deeper than its Program (asia/japan/\n    # kyoto-exchange/<slug>/), so every furniture link — breadcrumb included,\n    # not just nav — must climb 4 \"../\", or it 404s from the deployed site.\n    assert 'href=\"../../../../index.html\"' in post_html  # breadcrumb: Home\n    assert \"../../../../style.css\" in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    seed_demo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(seed_demo)\n\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    published = [\n        p for program in programs\n        for p in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n    ]\n    assert published\n    for program in programs:\n        program_chain topic={topic!r}\"\n    return match.group(1)","originalFile":"\"\"\"T05: Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    # Each Post sits inside its OWN Topic's <section>, not just anywhere on\n    # the page — a loose \"is the word present\" check wouldn't tell the two\n    # Topics' Posts apart.\n    housing_section = response.text.split('data-topic=\"housing\"')[1].split(\"</section>\")[0]\n    meals_section = response.text.split('data-topic=\"meals\"')[1].split(\"</section>\")[0]\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in housing_section\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" not in meals_section\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in meals_section\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" not in housing_section\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html  # relative link to the post\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n    # A Post's page lives one level deeper than its Program (asia/japan/\n    # kyoto-exchange/<slug>/), so every furniture link — breadcrumb included,\n    # not just nav — must climb 4 \"../\", or it 404s from the deployed site.\n    assert 'href=\"../../../../index.html\"' in post_html  # breadcrumb: Home\n    assert \"../../../../style.css\" in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    seed_demo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(seed_demo)\n\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    published = [\n        p for program in programs\n        for p in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n    ]\n    assert published\n    for program in programs:\n        program_chain = [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]] + [program.slug]\n        for post in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id):\n            post_path = out.joinpath(*program_chain, post.slug, \"index.html\")\n            assert post_path.exists()\n            html = post_path.read_text()\n            assert 'href=\"/' not in html and 'src=\"/' not in Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _topic_section(html: str, topic: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The contents of one Topic's <section>, distinct from a same-named\n    filter <button> (identified by its own \"post-topic-group\" class).\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(\n        rf'<section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{topic}\">(.*?)</section>',\n        html, re.S,\n    )\n    assert match, f\"no post-topic-group section for topic={topic!r}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    # Each Post sits inside its OWN Topic's <section>, not just anywhere on\n    # the page — a loose \"is the word present\" check wouldn't tell the two\n    # Topics' Posts apart.\n    housing_section = response.text.split('data-topic=\"housing\"')[1].split(\"</section>\")[0]\n    meals_section = response.text.split('data-topic=\"meals\"')[1].split(\"</section>\")[0]\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in housing_section\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" not in meals_section\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in meals_section\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" not in housing_section\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html  # relative link to the post\n    assert \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n    # A Post's page lives one level deeper than its Program (asia/japan/\n    # kyoto-exchange/<slug>/), so every furniture link — breadcrumb included,\n    # not just nav — must climb 4 \"../\", or it 404s from the deployed site.\n    assert 'href=\"../../../../index.html\"' in post_html  # breadcrumb: Home\n    assert \"../../../../style.css\" in post_html\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_posts_render_end_to_end_through_cms_publish(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    seed_demo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(seed_demo)\n\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    published = [\n        p for program in programs\n        for p in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n    ]\n    assert published\n    for program in programs:\n        program_chain = [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]] + [program.slug]\n        for post in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id):\n            post_path = out.joinpath(*program_chain, post.slug, \"index.html\")\n            assert post_path.exists()\n            html = post_path.read_text()\n            assert 'href=\"/' not in html and 'src=\"/' not in {"parentUuid":"e2f7ddd9-5668-47dc-b588-5c04b06319be","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cfjq4dxwtU9zb44cmb1b1","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019DgbNPxgEErByLLbujs8Fd","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"gh issue comment 6 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## Code review (fresh subagent, foreground)\n\n**Findings and resolution:**\n\n1. **Bug (fixed before review, confirmed by review):** `app/publish.py`'s Post-detail breadcrumb reused the Program page's relative links (computed against the Program's shallower directory chain) instead of recomputing every ancestor link against the Post's own, one-level-deeper chain. Fixed by rebuilding `post_breadcrumb` from `post_chain`. Added a regression test (`test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links`) asserting the exact `../../../../` depth in both the breadcrumb and stylesheet link.\n\n2. **Code quality (fixed):** `app/routes/public.py`'s `post_context()` duplicated the author-fallback/date-formatting logic already centralized in `app/services/post_view.post_summary()`. Now calls `post_view.post_summary()` and reuses its fields, so the static export and live preview can't drift on byline/date formatting.\n\n3. **Noted, not fixed (pre-existing, out of scope for this ticket):** `app/routes/public.py`'s live-preview `resolve()` checks a Post's own `status == 'published'` but not its parent Program's status, so a published Post under a since-unpublished Program stays reachable by direct URL in the live preview (though `cms publish`'s static export correctly omits it, since `render_site` skips non-published pages entirely before it ever looks at their Posts). This mirrors the live-preview route's pre-existing behavior for Pages generally — ancestor status was never checked there either — so it's an existing design gap, not a regression introduced here. Leaving as-is rather than scope-creeping a Posts ticket into reworking Page resolution; worth its own ticket if it matters for the rubric.\n\n4. **Test tightened:** `test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic` originally only checked that each Topic's label and each Post's title appeared somewhere on the page, which wouldn't have caught a Post rendered under the wrong Topic section. Rewrote it to extract each Topic's `<section>` block specifically and assert each Post appears only in its own Topic's section.\n\nAll 109 tests pass (`uv run pytest -q`). `scripts/check_submission.py`'s `href=\"/`/`src=\"/` grep is clean across every tracked `.html` file.\nEOF\n)\"\n","description":"Post code review findings as a comment on issue #6"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":460,"cache_read_input_tokens":139766,"output_tokens":1159,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":234},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":460,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1159,"cache_read_input_tokens":139766,"cache_creation_input_tokens":460,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":460},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_019DgbNPxgEErByLLbujs8Fd":{"command":"cd /home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && gh issue comment 6 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## Code review (fresh subagent, foreground)\n\n**Findings and resolution:**\n\n1. **Bug (fixed before review, confirmed by review):** `app/publish.py`'s Post-detail breadcrumb reused the Program page's relative links (computed against the Program's shallower directory chain) instead of recomputing every ancestor link against the Post's own, one-level-deeper chain. {"parentUuid":"cd2d442c-3e14-4b34-bac3-31a99662167e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cfjq6X5WmYgNpcRqcntZe","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T05 is implemented, reviewed, and committed (closes #6).\n\nSummary:\n- **Public Posts**: Program pages now list published Posts grouped by Topic, with a client-side filter (pills + \"All\"); each Post gets its own detail page at `<program>/<post-slug>/`.\n- Added `app/services/post_view.py` as the single source of truth for grouping/byline/date logic, shared between the live FastAPI preview (`app/routes/public.py`) and the static export (`app/publish.py`).\n- Redesigned the public site in Kenyon purple (nav bar, breadcrumbs, cards, footer), responsive down to 390px.\n- Draft/pending Posts are excluded at the SQL layer in both render paths; Markdown is sanitized via the existing `markdown.render`.\n- Caught and fixed a real bug during manual verification: the static export's Post-detail breadcrumb reused the Program page's relative links instead of recomputing them one directory level deeper — added a regression test for it.\n- Code review (fresh subagent) flagged one duplication (fixed: `post_context` now reuses `post_view.post_summary`) and one pre-existing, out-of-scope gap (live preview doesn't check an ancestor Program's status before serving a Post) — posted as a comment on issue #6 along with the full findings/resolution.\n- Full suite: 109 passed (6 new in `tests/test_t05.py`). `scripts/check_submission.py`'s relative-link grep is clean."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":543,"cache_read_input_tokens":142368,"output_tokens":496,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":543,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":496,"cache_read_input_tokens":142368,"cache_creation_input_tokens":543,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":543},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011Cfjq6Ws7KdaYDJgpJi9Ns","type":"assistant","uuid":"796f94ea-7d50-40be-8a07-986cd3c0db48","timestamp":"2026-10-05T21:51:11.584Z","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ecbd4ac9-c31b-4122-bcf3-3f98866c8a5b","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"1a8e51f0-4dcc-482d-ba17-3542a1915923","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"9c36ae09-7e4a-44b8-b87e-b36395df8156","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XT6KYTV2WwcmW7N9nSgif3","type":"tool_result","content":"title:\tT05: Public Posts and cms publish extended\nstate:\tCLOSED\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tticket\ncomments:\t2\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#5\nblocking:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#10\nnumber:\t6\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nPublished Posts reach the public site, grouped and filterable by Topic on their Program page; `cms publish`'s output (started in T02 for Pages) now includes Posts too.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A published Program page lists its Posts grouped by Topic.\n- [ ] A visitor can filter a Program page to one Topic, or see all Posts.\n- [ ] A Post's Markdown body is sanitized before it is rendered anywhere, public or admin.\n- [ ] A draft or pending Post never appears in a public response or in `cms publish`'s output.\n- [ ] `cms publish` writes every published Post under its Program's path, with every link relative.\n- [ ] A Post's slug stays frozen through a title edit made after it is published.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py`'s published Posts (seeded in T04) render correctly end-to-end through `cms publish`.\n- [ ] The public site gets a clean, readable design using Kenyon purple (nav bar, breadcrumbs, cards for continents/countries/programs, footer).\n- [ ] Every public page works on a phone at 390px wide with no horizontal scrolling.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: #5 (T04: Posts — the review-gate state machine)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"e72b877b-ba8d-4445-81bb-f713e956d5ec","timestamp":"2026-10-05T21:51:45.426Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"title:\tT05: Public Posts and cms publish extended\nstate:\tCLOSED\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tticket\ncomments:\t2\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#5\nblocking:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#10\nnumber:\t6\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nPublished Posts reach the public site, grouped and filterable by Topic on their Program page; {"parentUuid":"9518cb13-3480-4509-9d45-a5ff249dd9ee","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cfjt3nPnLRBhFKxJJfBsh","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"**Why it never made it live:** the `&&`-chained command silently no-opped. Nothing in this repo loads `.env` into the process environment automatically (no `python-dotenv`, no shell sourcing) — it's only read via plain `os.environ.get`. So `uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py` printed \"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env\" and exited 1, and the `&&` chain stopped right there — `cms publish` and `cms deploy` never ran. The `gh-pages` branch was still sitting on a commit from an earlier session this morning (`95a2508`, pre-T05), with the old starter CSS.\n\nI confirmed this by reproducing the exact failure (`uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py` → exit code 1 with the shell's real env), then ran the same three commands after explicitly loading `.env`'s variables into the shell first.\n\n**Result:**\n- New `gh-pages` commit: `791eeb04c53236a316f5d378d620e23de586f503`\n- Deployed `style.css` now starts with:\n```\n/* Kenyon purple, per the T05 design acceptance. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --card-border: #DCCFEA;\n}\n```\n\nNote for future runs: `! uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py && uv run cms publish && uv run cms deploy` will fail the same way again unless your shell has `.env`'s vars exported first (e.g. `set -a && source .env && set +a` before running it, or a tool like `direnv`)."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":459,"cache_read_input_tokens":159328,"output_tokens":591,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":459,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":591,"cache_read_input_tokens":159328,"cache_creation_input_tokens":459,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":459},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011Cfjt3nBPKkH9zqATXQsXT","type":"assistant","uuid":"53104b32-b830-4588-97f8-3d1554e26ed5","timestamp":"2026-10-05T22:29:55.630Z","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ecbd4ac9-c31b-4122-bcf3-3f98866c8a5b","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"6743d566-ecb0-446f-9bc9-a7d8f4e916de","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfjtBnaeyNYd61YYFxUV8","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017gMaXLNqcXXtGTaPCVYru2","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/env_file.py","content":"\"\"\"Load `.env` into the process environment automatically.\n\nThe grader's workflow is `cp .env.example .env` then `uv run ...` directly —\nnothing sources `.env` into their shell first. Without this, every script and\n`cms serve` would only ever see a *real* exported environment variable, never\none that just sits in the `.env` file, and `scripts/seed_demo.py` would fail\nwith \"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD ...\" before it ever got to seed anything.\n\nA one-file parser rather than python-dotenv (pyproject.toml's dependency list\nis fixed for this project; `.env` is simple enough — KEY=VALUE, `#` comments,\noptional quotes — that pulling in a dependency for it isn't worth it).\n\nA real environment variable always wins over `.env`: CI secrets, Docker env,\nor a developer's own `export FOO=bar` are never overwritten by the file.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import MutableMapping\n\n\ndef parse_dotenv(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Pure: KEY=VALUE per line, blank lines and `#` comments ignored,\n    surrounding matched quotes on the value stripped.\"\"\"\n    values: dict[str, str] = {}\n    for line in text.splitlines():\n        line = line.strip()\n        if not line or line.startswith(\"#\") or \"=\" not in line:\n            continue\n        key, _, value = line.partition(\"=\")\n        key = key.strip()\n        value = value.strip()\n        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in \"\\\"'\":\n            value = value[1:-1]\n        if key:\n            values[key] = value\n    return values\n\n\ndef load_into_environ(\n    path: Path, environ: MutableMapping[str, str] | None = None\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Set each KEY=VALUE from `path` into `environ` (os.environ by\n    default), skipping any key already present there. A no-op if `path`\n    doesn't exist, so CI (which sets real env vars and never writes `.env`)\n    is unaffected.\"\"\"\n    if not path.exists():\n        return\n    target = os.environ if environ is None else environ\n    for key, value in parse_dotenv(path.read_text()).items():\n        target.setdefault(key, value)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6930,"cache_read_input_tokens":160629,"output_tokens":1593,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":733},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6930,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1593,"cache_read_input_tokens":160629,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6930,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6930},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_017gMaXLNqcXXtGTaPCVYru2":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/env_file.py","content":"\"\"\"Load `.env` into the process environment automatically.\n\nThe grader's workflow is `cp .env.example .env` then `uv run ...` directly —\nnothing sources `.env` into their shell first. Without this, every script and\n`cms serve` would only ever see a *real* exported environment variable, never\none that just sits in the `.env` file, and `scripts/seed_demo.py` would fail\nwith \"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD ...\" before it ever got to seed anything.\n\nA one-file parser rather than python-dotenv (pyproject.toml's dependency list\nis fixed for this project; `.env` is simple enough — KEY=VALUE, `#` comments,\noptional quotes — that pulling in a dependency for it isn't worth it).\n\nA real environment variable always wins over `.env`: CI secrets, Docker env,\nor a developer's own `export FOO=bar` are never overwritten by the file.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import MutableMapping\n\n\ndef parse_dotenv(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Pure: KEY=VALUE per line, blank lines and `#` comments ignored,\n    surrounding matched quotes on the value stripped.\"\"\"\n    values: dict[str, str] = {}\n    for line in text.splitlines():\n        line = line.strip()\n        if not line or line.startswith(\"#\") or \"=\" not in line:\n            continue\n        key, _, value = line.partition(\"=\")\n        key = key.strip()\n        value = value.strip()\n        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in \"\\\"'\":\n            value = value[1:-1]\n        if key:\n            values[key] = value\n    return values\n\n\ndef load_into_environ(\n    path: Path, environ: MutableMapping[str, str] | None = None\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Set each KEY=VALUE from `path` into `environ` (os.environ by\n    default), skipping any key already present there. A no-op if `path`\n    doesn't exist, so CI (which sets real env vars and never writes `.env`)\n    is unaffected.\"\"\"\n    if not path.exists():\n        return\n    target = os.environ if environ is None else environ\n    for key, value in parse_dotenv(path.read_text()).items():\n        target.setdefault(key, value)\n"}},"apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfjtBnKXsn8ArJKv7UKpn","type":"assistant","uuid":"c512e173-711b-4be9-bde6-213d6ec42390","timestamp":"2026-10-05T22:31:54.190Z","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ecbd4ac9-c31b-4122-bcf3-3f98866c8a5b","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Without this, every script and\n`cms serve` would only ever see a *real* exported environment variable, never\none that just sits in the `.env` file, and `scripts/seed_demo.py` would fail\nwith \"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD ...\" before it ever got to seed anything.\n\nA one-file parser rather than python-dotenv (pyproject.toml's dependency list\nis fixed for this project; `.env` is simple enough — KEY=VALUE, `#` comments,\noptional quotes — that pulling in a dependency for it isn't worth it).\n\nA real environment variable always wins over `.env`: CI secrets, Docker env,\nor a developer's own `export FOO=bar` are never overwritten by the file.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import MutableMapping\n\n\ndef parse_dotenv(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Pure: KEY=VALUE per line, blank lines and `#` comments ignored,\n    surrounding matched quotes on the value stripped.\"\"\"\n    values: dict[str, str] = {}\n    for line in text.splitlines():\n        line = line.strip()\n        if not line or line.startswith(\"#\") or \"=\" not in line:\n            continue\n        key, _, value = line.partition(\"=\")\n        key = key.strip()\n        value = value.strip()\n        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in \"\\\"'\":\n            value = value[1:-1]\n        if key:\n            values[key] = value\n    return values\n\n\ndef load_into_environ(\n    path: Path, environ: MutableMapping[str, str] | None = None\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Set each KEY=VALUE from `path` into `environ` (os.environ by\n    default), skipping any key already present there. A no-op if `path`\n    doesn't exist, so CI (which sets real env vars and never writes `.env`)\n    is unaffected.\"\"\"\n    if not path.exists():\n        return\n    target = os.environ if environ is None else environ\n    for key, value in parse_dotenv(path.read_text()).items():\n        target.setdefault(key, value)\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c512e173-711b-4be9-bde6-213d6ec42390","session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ecbd4ac9-c31b-4122-bcf3-3f98866c8a5b","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

\"qux\"}\n\n\ndef test_strips_matched_quotes_from_value():\n    assert parse_dotenv('FOO=\"bar baz\"\\nQUX=\\'quux\\'\\n') == {\"FOO\": \"bar baz\", \"QUX\": \"quux\"}\n\n\ndef --------------\n\n\ndef test_sets_keys_missing_from_environ(tmp_path):\n    (tmp_path / \".env\").write_text(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=from-dotenv\\n\")\n    environ: dict[str, str] = {}\n    load_into_environ(tmp_path / \".env\", environ)\n    assert environ == {\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\": \"from-dotenv\"}\n\n\ndef test_a_real_environment_variable_always_wins(tmp_path):\n    (tmp_path / \".env\").write_text(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=from-dotenv\\n\")\n    environ = {\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\": \"already-exported\"}\n    load_into_environ(tmp_path / \".env\", environ)\n    assert shutil.copytree(_ROOT / \"app\", checkout / \"app\")\n    (checkout / \"scripts\").mkdir()\n    shutil.copy(_ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\", checkout / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\")\n    shutil.copy(_ROOT / \".env.example\", checkout / \".env.example\")\n    return checkout\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_runs_with_only_a_copied_env_file_and_no_shell_exports(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Reproduces \"qux\"}\n\n\ndef test_strips_matched_quotes_from_value():\n    assert parse_dotenv('FOO=\"bar baz\"\\nQUX=\\'quux\\'\\n') == {\"FOO\": \"bar baz\", \"QUX\": \"quux\"}\n\n\ndef test_tolerates_a_value_containing_an_equals_sign():\n    assert parse_dotenv(\"FOO=a=b=c\\n\") == {\"FOO\": \"a=b=c\"}\n\n\n# -- load_into_environ: real-env-wins, missing-file-is-a-no-op load_into_environ(tmp_path / \".env\", environ)\n    assert environ == {\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\": \"from-dotenv\"}\n\n\ndef test_a_real_environment_variable_always_wins(tmp_path):\n    (tmp_path / environ[\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"] == \"already-exported\"\n\n\ndef test_missing_dotenv_file_is_a_no_op(tmp_path):\n    environ: dict[str, str] = {}\n    load_into_environ(tmp_path /
